svg.title: A2: finite Gaussian normalization. The extraction at line 1317 has exponent −rh + dv; the correct exponent in the finite integral identity is −(rh + dv). Here r is the color dimension, h the active free-link count, f the total free tree-gauge link count, rh the active real dimension, and dv the dormant real dimension. Thus f −h free links are frozen and the ambient fluctuation dimension is rh + dv. Set K = √ 2π and mg = c(Kg)r, where c is the Haar chart scale. Cancellation of frozen factors gives the exact substitution
